instruction_en: Turn right to enter the room with wooden flooring, passing a decorative stand on your left and a series of wooden wardrobes on your right. Walk straight ahead through this room towards the open doorway in front of you. Go through the doorway into the tiled hallway. On your right is a wall with a tall green decoration, and on your left is a smaller doorway leading to a room with a window. Continue walking straight down the hallway, passing a round wooden art piece on the wall to your right. Enter the open living and dining area, and stop with the dining table and kitchen on your left.
